brief: Three bases arranged around an empty spot, with a bay tray standing in that spot.

requirements.requirement: Three bases arranged around an empty spot
requirements.evidence: Full hex bases piece:0,0,0, piece:1,0,0 and piece:0,-1,0 all border the empty cell (1,-1,0), each touching the other two. The original base at (0,0) was kept as one of the three.

requirements.requirement: A bay tray standing in that empty spot
requirements.evidence: Full bay tray (hex-bin-bay-n-full-solid, 'Full bay tray, north bay') added via addNotch at cell (1,-1,0); it is recorded as bay:0#1,-1#bay3. check_build reports meshClash 'clear' with no rule errors (only an informational open-cap note).

finish.summary: Built three full hex bases at (0,0), (1,0) and (0,-1) around the empty cell (1,-1), with a full-depth bay tray seated in that cell. The configurator accepts the build with a clear mesh check. No props or other parts were added.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
